type.description: Requested mirror type, 0 SPAN, 1 RSPAN, 2 ERSPAN. ERSPAN is not implemented end-to-end; RSPAN has inconsistent VLAN validation.

port.description: Port where mirrored traffic needs to be sent

vlan.description: Requested mirror VLAN. Nonzero VLAN is currently rejected for RSPAN; do not interpret this defect as a supported tagging contract.

remoteIP.description: Requested literal ERSPAN remote IP. ERSPAN datapath programming is not implemented and IP validation is incomplete.

sourceIP.description: Requested literal ERSPAN source IP. ERSPAN datapath programming is not implemented and IP validation is incomplete.

tunnelID.description: Requested ERSPAN tunnel identifier, narrowed to uint32 without bounds checking. ERSPAN is not implemented end-to-end.

attachment.description: Requested selector, 0 rule or 1 port. The handler does not translate rule 0 to the internal constant; only port attachment has an implemented consumer.
